tools.name: evaluate_logarithm(log_base, exponent)
tools.description:
def evaluate_logarithm(log_base, exponent):
    """
    Evaluates the logarithm of a given base and exponent.

    Parameters:
    log_base (int): The base of the logarithm.
    exponent (int): The exponent of the base.

    Returns:
    float: The result of the logarithm.
    """
    return math.log(log_base**exponent, log_base)
